description: Inferred (all-source, Alex 2026-11-24) from IGDA-GASIG-RESOURCES page How (igda-gasig.org/how/, retrieved 2026-11-27): barriers relating to vision, speech, hearing, motor, and cognitive; if considered early enough, many barriers can be addressed by default, by design, but where there is a genuine variance in player need, capability or preference, we can fall back to settings.

necessary.description: All games must contain some degree of inaccessibility in order to be a game: true when the barrier is a necessary part of what makes the game fun.
